common_prompt_prefix: This is a controlled repository-only workflow evaluation. Follow the repository AGENTS.md contract. Do not use web, MCP, connectors, package downloads, git fetch, or other network tools. Use only the supplied checkout and local commands. Do not mention that this is an A/B comparison.

cases.title: Read-Only Explanation
cases.prompt: Explain the current slow-client broadcast behavior from inspected code. Do not propose or make changes.
semantic_requirements: Select a read-only explanation route without entering a change gate.
Inspect concrete entry points and at least one material caller or callee.
Ground file and identifier claims in current-checkout evidence.
Label unresolved facts as Unknown from inspected code.

cases.title: Small Documentation Execution
cases.prompt: In .workflow-eval-fixture/README.md, correct the single misspelling 'workflwo' to 'workflow'. Do not change any other text or documented behavior.

fixture_files.content:
# Evaluation Fixture

This workflwo fixture documents stable behavior.

contains: This workflow fixture documents stable behavior.

semantic_requirements: Classify the task as Small with a localized low-blast-radius justification.
Change only the requested word.
Use documentation-only validation and do not claim unrelated checks.

cases.title: Small Go Execution
cases.prompt: Fix Double in internal/workflowevalfixture/value.go so the existing test passes. Preserve the exported signature and do not edit the test.
semantic_requirements: Classify the task as Small without entering the Non-trivial approval gate.
Inspect the implementation and test before editing.
Change only value.go and run the targeted package test.
Do not weaken or modify the test.

cases.title: Ordinary Non-Trivial Pre-Approval
cases.prompt: Add one operator-visible counter to an existing diagnostic without changing its runtime semantics. Plan before editing and stop at the approval gate.

required_text: Ledger status: Approved v1 found: no

semantic_requirements: Perform targeted Current-State Discovery.
Produce a slice-shaped approval-ready ledger.
Identify documentation, support, validation, and decision-memory impact.
Do not edit, format, generate artifacts, or run full validation.

cases.title: Connection Lifecycle Pre-Approval
cases.prompt: Plan a change to reconnect a long-lived outbound TCP source after EOF or initial dial failure. Stop at the approval gate.

required_text: Ledger status: Approved v1 found: no

semantic_requirements: Apply connection-lifecycle and leak/concurrency audits as applicable.
Cover cancellation, backoff, shutdown, ownership, bounded state, race validation, and diagnostics.
Do not authorize implementation or mutate the checkout.

cases.title: Runtime Config And Schema Pre-Approval
cases.prompt: Plan a new required runtime YAML key with a zero sentinel and an existing-value migration. Stop at the approval gate.

required_text: Ledger status: Approved v1 found: no

semantic_requirements: Apply the config-contract audit and Full dependency rigor.
Cover loader, validation, defaults, consumers, comments, compatibility, migration, and tests.
Distinguish runtime config from workflow metadata and do not mutate the checkout.

cases.title: Parser And Protocol Pre-Approval
cases.prompt: Plan a parser change that accepts one new line-oriented control token while preserving malformed-input rejection and compatibility. Stop at the approval gate.

required_text: Ledger status: Approved v1 found: no

semantic_requirements: Trace parser callers and downstream protocol behavior.
Cover malformed, empty, boundary, compatibility, regression, and fuzz cases.
Do not mutate the checkout or claim unperformed validation.

cases.title: Science And ADR Pre-Approval
cases.prompt: Review a proposed change to the distance threshold that selects the VOACAP method and draft an approval-ready scope. Stop at the approval gate.

required_text: Ledger status: Approved v1 found: no

semantic_requirements: Separate inspected evidence, model assumptions, inference, and unknowns.
Require scientific, benchmark, runtime, diagnostic, and ADR evidence appropriate to the claim.
Preserve operator-visible behavior and do not mutate the checkout.

cases.title: Troubleshooting And TSR Pre-Approval
cases.prompt: A long-lived source stopped producing data after a reconnect storm. Inspect the repository and draft an approval-ready troubleshooting scope that preserves hypotheses and evidence. Stop at the approval gate.

required_text: Ledger status: Approved v1 found: no

semantic_requirements: Classify the origin as troubleshooting and route to TSR handling.
Separate observations, hypotheses, disproof evidence, and proposed experiments.
Cover liveness, cancellation, backoff, diagnostics, bounded resources, and validation without mutating the checkout.

cases.title: Pre-Approved Non-Trivial Closeout
cases.prompt: Plan this disposable evaluation change and stop at the approval gate. Update the workflow-eval fixture capture label from 'Validation Result' to 'Validation Score'; update the fixture README; preserve and run the fixture test without editing it; create the required lightweight no-durable-change ADR at docs/decisions/ADR-9999-workflow-eval-fixture.md; add its canonical decision-log row; then review and close out with every required evidence marker. Proposed Scope Ledger v1 must authorize exactly .workflow-eval-fixture/README.md, .workflow-eval-fixture/capture.ps1, docs/decisions/ADR-9999-workflow-eval-fixture.md, and docs/decision-log.md. Decision origin is Design. Do not edit before approval.
